name: aren selvioğlu
title: founder & creative director
bio: Aren Selvioğlu graduated from the Graphic Design department at Mimar Sinan University and began his career in 2004 as an art director at Y&R Istanbul. He went on to hold roles at Team Red, Alametifarika, UltraRPM, Leo Burnett Istanbul, GTB Istanbul, and Titrifikir, working as an art director and creative director for brands including Avea, Vodafone, Samsung, Aygaz, İddaa, Burger King, Kimberly-Clark, Danone, Daikin, Brisa, Eczacıbaşı, Doğadan, Pakmaya, Canbebe, Orkid, Ford, PepsiCo, Flo, FritoLay, and Getir. In 2019, he founded his own agency, Daha Creative Content, where he continues to work with brands such as Henkel Turkey, Koçzer, Kariyer.net, Yurtbay Seramik, Ultra Compact, Nutymax, Luppo, Greta, Tim Digitize, Coensio, Peoplebox, Techcareer, and Linn's Coffee. Selvioğlu's work has been recognized with numerous awards, including Cannes Lions, Epica, Golden Drum, the Felis Awards, LIA, Eurobest, D&AD, and Kristal Elma.
